steps.title: Deplete ribosomes from RRL
steps.instruction: Load 1 mL rabbit reticulocyte lysate (RRL) into a 1.5 mL DNA LoBind tube placed in an 11 mm Delrin adapter and ultracentrifuge at 240,000 × g for 2 h 15 min at 4 °C; keep the sample on ice, collect 900 µL supernatant, transfer to a new LoBind tube, flash‑freeze with liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C, avoiding the ribosomal pellet and optionally aliquoting to prevent freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Harvest HEK293 cells
steps.instruction: Seed 5 × 10⁶ HEK293T (naïve or METTL18 KO) cells per 10 cm dish in 10 mL DMEM + 10 % FBS (prepare 10 dishes) and incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; wash each dish twice with ice‑cold PBS (5 mL then 1 mL), resuspend cells, pool into a 15 mL tube, centrifuge 500 × g 3 min 4 °C, discard supernatant, add 1 mL ice‑cold PBS, repeat centrifugation in a 1.5 mL LoBind tube, weigh the tube with pellet (~300 mg).

steps.title: Lyse cells in Buffer R
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in Buffer R at a volume equal to the pellet mass (e.g., 300 µL for 300 mg), incubate on ice 15 min, vortex 30 s, centrifuge 16,000 × g 10 min 4 °C, collect the supernatant in a LoBind tube and keep 10 µL for Coomassie staining.

steps.title: Sucrose‑cushion ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Load 300 µL clarified lysate at the bottom of a 3.2 mL polycarbonate tube, underlay slowly with 1 mL sucrose cushion using a PIPETMAN P‑1000 (or cannula), mark the tube side for the pellet, ultracentrifuge 240,000 × g 2 h 15 min 4 °C; discard supernatant, add 100 µL Buffer R2 to the bottom, discard supernatant, add 30 µL Buffer R2, place a stir bar in the tube and stir at 4 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Resuspend ribosome pellet and quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the stirred ribosome suspension to a 1.5 mL LoBind tube, keep 1 µL for staining; if not fully dissolved stir another 15 min. Prepare Qubit RNA BR working solution (200‑fold dilution of reagent in buffer). For each standard and sample add 190 µL working solution + 10 µL standard or 199 µL working solution + 1 µL ribosome sample, vortex 2‑3 s, incubate RT 2 min, read on Qubit 2.0, calculate RNA concentration (ng/µL), convert to ribosome concentration using MW = 2.2 × 10⁶ Da (conc = ng/µL ÷ 2.2 × 10⁶), dilute to 226 nM with Buffer R2, flash‑freeze and store at –80 °C, aliquoting to avoid repeat freeze‑thaw.

steps.title: SDS‑PAGE analysis of ribosome preparation
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µL cell‑lysate, 1 µL ribosome solution, 9 µL Buffer R2 and 10 µL 2× Laemmli sample buffer in a LoBind tube, heat 95 °C 10 min; load 20 µL of each sample plus 5 µL BlueStar ladder onto a 5 %–20 % polyacrylamide gel, run at constant 20 mA for 70 min at RT; fix gel 15 mL gel‑fixation buffer 30 min shaking, wash twice with Milli‑Q water, stain 15 mL GelCode Blue 60 min shaking, wash, destain with water until background low (≈3 h‑overnight), image on Odyssey CLx.

steps.title: PCR amplify transcription templates
steps.instruction: In a 0.2 mL PCR tube combine 1 µL plasmid (0.01 ng/µL), 4 µL Primer 1 (5 µM), 4 µL Primer 2 (5 µM), 50 µL PrimeSTAR Max 2×, 41 µL RNase‑free water (total 100 µL). Thermocycle: 98 °C 10 s; 30 × (98 °C 10 s, 55 °C 5 s, 72 °C 35 s); 72 °C 1 min; hold 4 °C. Mix PCR product with 10× loading buffer, run on 1 % agarose gel with 1 kb ladder in TAE, stain with GreenView, visualize, excise ~2.8 kb band, gel‑purify with NucleoSpin kit, measure DNA concentration (DS‑11).

steps.title: In‑vitro transcription of reporter RNAs
steps.instruction: Set up 20 µL IVT reaction: 1 µg purified DNA template (volume X), 2 µL 10× T7‑Scribe buffer, 1.5 µL each of 100 mM ATP, CTP, UTP, GTP, 2 µL 100 mM DTT, 0.5 µL 40 U/µL ScriptGuard, 2 µL T7‑Scribe enzyme, RNase‑free water to 20 µL. Incubate 37 °C 2 h (optional 4‑6 h). Add 1 µL DNase I, incubate 37 °C 2 h. Purify RNA with Agencourt RNAClean XP beads (1.8× volume), mix, incubate RT 15 min, magnet 5 min, discard supernatant, wash 3× with 200 µL 70 % ethanol (keep on magnet), dry 5 min (avoid overdry), elute 20 µL RNase‑free water, incubate RT 2 min, magnet 2 min, transfer eluate to LoBind tube, store –20 °C/–80 °C. Measure concentration (DS‑11), typical ≈1 µg/µL.

steps.title: Denature RNA for capping
steps.instruction: Adjust RNA to 20‑30 µg in a total volume of 33.5 µL with RNase‑free water, incubate 65 °C 5 min, then place immediately on ice.

steps.title: Cap RNA with ScriptCap system
steps.instruction: In a 0.2 mL tube combine 33.5 µL denatured RNA, 5 µL 10× ScriptCap capping buffer, 5 µL 10 mM GTP, 1.25 µL 20 mM SAM, 1.25 µL 40 U/µL ScriptGuard, 2 µL 100 U/µL ScriptCap 2′‑O‑methyltransferase, 2 µL 10 U/µL ScriptCap capping enzyme, water to 50 µL; incubate 37 °C 30 min.

steps.title: Add poly(A) tail
steps.instruction: Set up 66 µL tailing reaction: 50 µL capping reaction, 0.3 µL 40 U/µL ScriptGuard, 6.6 µL 10× A‑Plus poly(A) buffer, 6.6 µL 20 mM ATP, 2.5 µL 4 U/µL A‑Plus poly(A) polymerase, water to 66 µL; incubate 37 °C 30 min, then add 2.5 µL 0.5 M EDTA (final ≈18 mM) to stop the reaction. Store at –20 °C before purification.

steps.title: Purify capped and tailed RNA
steps.instruction: Purify the 66 µL reaction using the same Agencourt RNAClean XP bead protocol described in step 8; elute in RNase‑free water, store at –20 °C/–80 °C.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality with fragment analyzer
steps.instruction: Bring separation buffer, marker solution, SYBR Green stock, and RNA 6000 ladder to RT; dilute SYBR Green 1:100 in TE, dilute ladder 1:6 in TE, dilute each RNA sample to 25‑250 ng/µL. Prepare 5 mL tube with 1 µL diluted SYBR Green, 80 µL formamide, 319 µL separation buffer (total 400 µL). In 0.2 mL PCR tubes add 3 µL diluted RNA (or ladder) and 3 µL marker solution, incubate 65 °C 5 min, ice. Load tubes onto MultiNA, run with MultiNA Control Software. From the electropherogram obtain ng/µL, estimate poly(A) length, calculate molecular weight (nt × 320.5 Da), compute molarity (ng/µL ÷ MW), and dilute the reporter mRNA to 11 nM with RNase‑free water.

steps.title: In‑vitro translation reaction
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL LoBind tube combine 60 µL ribosome‑depleted RRL, 12 µL purified ribosome (226 nM, final 22.6 nM), 12 µL reporter mRNA (11 nM, final 1.1 nM), 12 µL Buffer KM (75 mM KCl, 0.75 mM MgCl₂), 12 µL 200 µM amino‑acid mixture (final 20 µM), 2.4 µL 40 U/µL RNase inhibitor (0.8 U/µL), 9.6 µL RNase‑free water (total 120 µL). Incubate at 25 °C; at 0, 5, 10,… 50 min withdraw 10 µL into a LoBind tube, add 20 µL 1× passive lysis buffer, keep on ice.

steps.title: Luciferase assay
steps.instruction: Prepare LAR II working solution by dissolving the lyophilized substrate in 10 mL assay buffer II (enough for (samples + 1) × 50 µL + 500 µL). Prepare Stop & Glo working solution by mixing 55 µL 50× substrate with 2,695 µL buffer. Prime GloMax injectors with each solution, program a 2 s pre‑delay and 10 s measurement, dispense 50 µL of each reagent per sample. Transfer 20 µL quenched translation sample to each well of a white 96‑well plate, place in GloMax Navigator, run assay, and export luminescence data as a CSV file.
